# --- AcceleratedKernels.jl integration ---
@kernel function compute_distances_kernel(output, coords1, coords2)
    i, j = @index(Global, NTuple)
    
    diff_x = coords1[i, 1] - coords2[j, 1]
    diff_y = coords1[i, 2] - coords2[j, 2]
    diff_z = coords1[i, 3] - coords2[j, 3]
    
    output[i, j] = sqrt(diff_x^2 + diff_y^2 + diff_z^2)
end

function accelerated_distance_matrix(coords::AbstractMatrix)
    @debug "Computing distance matrix with AcceleratedKernels on $(typeof(BACKEND))"
    dev_coords = KernelAbstractions.asarray(coords, BACKEND)
    n_atoms = size(dev_coords, 1)
    dist_matrix_dev = KernelAbstractions.zeros(BACKEND, Float32, n_atoms, n_atoms)
    kernel = compute_distances_kernel(BACKEND)
    kernel(dist_matrix_dev, dev_coords, dev_coords, ndrange=(n_atoms, n_atoms))
    KernelAbstractions.synchronize(BACKEND)
    return Array(dist_matrix_dev) # Move back to CPU for further processing if needed
end

function l2norm(t::AbstractArray, dim=-1; eps=1e-20)
    @debug "L2 normalization: shape=$(size(t)), dim=$dim"
    dims_arg = dim == -1 ? ndims(t) : dim
    norm_val = sqrt.(sum(t .^ 2, dims=dims_arg) .+ eps)
    return t ./ norm_val
end

function symmetrize(t::AbstractArray{T,3}) where T
    @debug "Symmetrizing tensor: shape=$(size(t))"
    return t + permutedims(t, (2,1,3))
end

function masked_average(t::AbstractArray, mask::AbstractArray, dims; eps=1.0)
    @debug "Masked average: t_shape=$(size(t)), mask_shape=$(size(mask)), dims=$dims"
    num = sum(t .* mask, dims=dims)
    den = sum(mask, dims=dims)
    return num ./ max.(den, eps)
end

function exclusive_cumsum(t::AbstractArray, dim=-1)
    @debug "Exclusive cumulative sum: shape=$(size(t)), dim=$dim"
    if dim == -1
        dim = ndims(t)
    end
    s = size(t)
    cum = cumsum(t, dims=dim)
    shifted = zeros(eltype(t), s...)
    
    # Create indexers for slicing
    colons = [(:) for _ in 1:ndims(t)]
    
    src_indices = copy(colons)
    src_indices[dim] = 1:size(t, dim)-1
    
    dest_indices = copy(colons)
    dest_indices[dim] = 2:size(t, dim)
    
    shifted[dest_indices...] = cum[src_indices...]
    return shifted
end

# Padding and reshaping utilities
function pad(t::AbstractArray, pads)
    @debug "Padding tensor: shape=$(size(t)), pads=$pads"
    current_size = size(t)
    new_size = current_size .+ pads
    padded = zeros(eltype(t), new_size...)
    slices = [1:s for s in current_size]
    padded[slices...] = t
    return padded
end

function unpad(t::AbstractArray, pads)
    @debug "Unpadding tensor: shape=$(size(t)), pads=$pads"
    slices = [p+1:size(t,i) for (i, p) in enumerate(pads)]
    return t[slices...]
end

function reshape_for_attention(t::AbstractArray, num_heads::Int, dim_head::Int)
    @debug "Reshaping for attention: shape=$(size(t)), heads=$num_heads, dim_head=$dim_head"
    batch, seq, _ = size(t)

end

# Attention and related components with optimized implementations
struct Attend
    flash::Bool
    scale_factor::Float32
end

function Attend(; flash=DEFAULT_FLASH_ATTENTION, scale_factor=1.0f0)
    @debug "Initializing Attend: flash=$flash, scale_factor=$scale_factor"
    Attend(flash, scale_factor)
end

function (att::Attend)(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray; mask=nothing, bias=nothing)
    @debug "Attend computation: q_shape=$(size(q)), k_shape=$(size(k)), v_shape=$(size(v))"
    scale = att.scale_factor / sqrt(size(q, ndims(q)))
    
    # Manually implement batch matrix multiplication for more control if needed
    # Here we use einsum for clarity and potential optimization by Einsum.jl
    @einsum scores[b, h, i, j] := q[b, h, i, d] * k[b, h, j, d]
    scores = scores .* scale

    if exists(bias)
        scores = scores .+ bias
    end
    if exists(mask)
        mask_value = max_neg_value(scores)
        scores = scores .+ (1 .- mask) .* mask_value
    end
    attn_weights = softmax(scores, dims=4)
    @einsum result[b, h, i, d] := attn_weights[b, h, i, j] * v[b, h, j, d]
    @info "Attend completed: result_shape=$(size(result))"
    return result
end

struct Attention

Flux.@functor Attention

function Attention(dim::Int; num_heads=DEFAULT_NUM_HEADS, dim_head=64, flash=DEFAULT_FLASH_ATTENTION)
    @debug "Initializing Attention: heads=$num_heads, dim=$dim, dim_head=$dim_head, flash=$flash"
    inner_dim = num_heads * dim_head
    q_proj = Flux.Dense(dim, inner_dim, bias=false)
    k_proj = Flux.Dense(dim, inner_dim, bias=false)
    v_proj = Flux.Dense(dim, inner_dim, bias=false)
    out_proj = Flux.Dense(inner_dim, dim)
    Attention(num_heads, dim, dim_head, Attend(flash=flash), q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, out_proj)
end

function (attn::Attention)(x::AbstractArray; mask=nothing, bias=nothing)
    @debug "Attention computation: x_shape=$(size(x))"
    q = attn.q_proj(x)
    k = attn.k_proj(x)
    v = attn.v_proj(x)
    
    q_reshaped = reshape_for_attention(q, attn.num_heads, attn.dim_head)
    k_reshaped = reshape_for_attention(k, attn.num_heads, attn.dim_head)
    v_reshaped = reshape_for_attention(v, attn.num_heads, attn.dim_head)
    
    out_reshaped = attn.attend(q_reshaped, k_reshaped, v_reshaped; mask=mask, bias=bias)
    
    # Reshape back
    batch, _, seq, _ = size(out_reshaped)
    out = reshape(permutedims(out_reshaped, (1, 3, 2, 4)), batch, seq, :)
    
    return attn.out_proj(out)
end


# Relative position encoding with advanced features
struct RelativePositionEncoding
    dim::Int
    max_dist::Int
    positional_encoding::Matrix{Float32}
end

Flux.@functor RelativePositionEncoding

function RelativePositionEncoding(dim::Int; max_dist=32)
    @debug "Initializing RelativePositionEncoding: dim=$dim, max_dist=$max_dist"
    pe = zeros(Float32, 2 * max_dist + 1, dim)
    position = -max_dist:max_dist
    div_term = exp.(collect(0:2:dim-1) .* (-Base.log(10000.0f0) / dim))'
    
    pe[:, 1:2:end] = sin.(position * div_term[:, 1:2:end])
    pe[:, 2:2:end] = cos.(position * div_term[:, 2:2:end])
    
    RelativePositionEncoding(dim, max_dist, pe)
end

function (rpe::RelativePositionEncoding)(residue_index::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing relative position encoding: residue_index_shape=$(size(residue_index))"
    rel_pos = residue_index .- residue_index'
    rel_pos_clamped = clamp.(rel_pos, -rpe.max_dist, rpe.max_dist)
    indices = rel_pos_clamped .+ rpe.max_dist .+ 1
    return rpe.positional_encoding[indices, :]
end

# SmoothLDDTLoss with numerical stability
struct SmoothLDDTLoss
    num_bins::Int
    min_dist::Float32
    max_dist::Float32
end

Flux.@functor SmoothLDDTLoss

function SmoothLDDTLoss(; num_bins=CONFIDENCE_BINS, min_dist=0.0f0, max_dist=15.0f0)
    @debug "Initializing SmoothLDDTLoss: num_bins=$num_bins, min_dist=$min_dist, max_dist=$max_dist"
    SmoothLDDTLoss(num_bins, min_dist, max_dist)
end

function (loss::SmoothLDDTLoss)(pred::AbstractArray, true_val::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing SmoothLDDTLoss: pred_shape=$(size(pred)), true_shape=$(size(true_val))"
    # Assuming pred is logits for bins and true_val is actual distances
    bin_edges = LinRange(loss.min_dist, loss.max_dist, loss.num_bins + 1)
    bin_centers = (bin_edges[1:end-1] .+ bin_edges[2:end]) ./ 2
    
    bin_probs = softmax(pred, dims=3)
    
    # Expand dims for broadcasting
    true_dist_expanded = reshape(true_val, size(true_val)..., 1)
    bin_centers_expanded = reshape(bin_centers, 1, 1, :)
    
    l = sum(abs.(true_dist_expanded .- bin_centers_expanded) .* bin_probs, dims=3)
    return mean(l)
end


# WeightedRigidAlign with robust alignment
struct WeightedRigidAlign
    weights::AbstractArray
    epsilon::Float32
end

Flux.@functor WeightedRigidAlign

function WeightedRigidAlign(weights::AbstractArray; epsilon=1e-6f0)
    @debug "Initializing WeightedRigidAlign: weights_shape=$(size(weights)), epsilon=$epsilon"
    WeightedRigidAlign(weights, epsilon)
end

function (wra::WeightedRigidAlign)(pred_coords::AbstractArray, true_coords::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing WeightedRigidAlign: pred_shape=$(size(pred_coords)), true_shape=$(size(true_coords))"
    weights_norm = wra.weights ./ (sum(wra.weights) + wra.epsilon)
    pred_center = sum(pred_coords .* weights_norm, dims=1)
    true_center = sum(true_coords .* weights_norm, dims=1)
    pred_shifted = pred_coords .- pred_center
    true_shifted = true_coords .- true_center
    cov = pred_shifted' * diagm(vec(weights_norm)) * true_shifted
    decomp = svd(cov)
    rot = decomp.U * decomp.Vt
    aligned = pred_shifted * rot
    return aligned .+ true_center
end

    @showprogress for perm in perms
        permuted_coords = similar(coords)

            mask_orig = chain_mask .== unique_chains[i]

# CentreRandomAugmentation with controlled randomness
struct CentreRandomAugmentation
    max_translation::Float32
    max_rotation::Float32
end

Flux.@functor CentreRandomAugmentation

function CentreRandomAugmentation(; max_translation=5.0f0, max_rotation=pi/6)
    @debug "Initializing CentreRandomAugmentation: max_translation=$max_translation, max_rotation=$max_rotation"
    CentreRandomAugmentation(max_translation, max_rotation)
end

function (cra::CentreRandomAugmentation)(coords::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Applying random augmentation: coords_shape=$(size(coords))"
    translation = (rand(Float32, 3) .* 2 .* cra.max_translation) .- cra.max_translation
    theta = (rand(Float32) * 2 * cra.max_rotation) - cra.max_rotation
    rot_axis = randn(Float32, 3)
    rot_axis = rot_axis / norm(rot_axis)
    rot_matrix = angle_axis_to_matrix(theta, rot_axis)
    center = mean(coords, dims=1)
    coords_centered = coords .- center
    coords_rotated = coords_centered * rot_matrix
    return coords_rotated .+ center .+ translation'
end

function angle_axis_to_matrix(theta::Float32, axis::Vector{Float32})
    @debug "Computing rotation matrix: theta=$theta, axis=$axis"
    c = cos(theta)
    s = sin(theta)
    t = 1 - c
    x, y, z = axis
    return [
        t*x*x+c     t*x*y-z*s   t*x*z+y*s;
        t*x*y+z*s   t*y*y+c     t*y*z-x*s;
        t*x*z-y*s   t*y*z+x*s   t*z*z+c
    ]
end

struct Trainer

function Trainer(config::TrainerConfig)
    @debug "Initializing Trainer: learning_rate=$(config.learning_rate), batch_size=$(config.batch_size)"
    model = Alphafold3(config.model_config)
    optimizer = Flux.Adam(config.learning_rate, (0.9, 0.999), config.weight_decay)
    
    loss_fn = (pred, true_data) -> begin
        coords_pred, conf_pred, dist_pred = pred
        coords_true, conf_true, dist_true = true_data
        
        coord_loss = mean((coords_pred .- coords_true) .^ 2)
        # Assuming conf_true and dist_true are binned targets for CE loss
        conf_loss = Flux.logitcrossentropy(conf_pred, conf_true)
        dist_loss = Flux.logitcrossentropy(dist_pred, dist_true)
        
        return coord_loss + conf_loss + dist_loss
    end
    
    Trainer(config, model, optimizer, loss_fn)
end

function train_step!(trainer::Trainer, batch)
    ps = Flux.params(trainer.model)
    loss, grads = Flux.withgradient(ps) do
        # Assuming batch is a tuple of (features, targets)
        features, targets = batch
        predictions = trainer.model(features)
        trainer.loss_fn(predictions, targets)
    end
    Flux.update!(trainer.optimizer, ps, grads)
    return loss
end

function train!(trainer::Trainer, dataset; device_type=DEVICE_TYPE)
    @info "Starting training: device=$device_type, dataset_size=$(length(dataset))"
    model = to_device(trainer.model, device_type)
    
    for epoch in 1:trainer.config.num_epochs
        @info "Epoch $epoch"
        total_loss = 0.0f0
        
        progress = Progress(length(dataset))
        for (i, batch) in enumerate(dataset)
            batch = to_device(batch, device_type)
            loss = train_step!(trainer, batch)
            total_loss += loss
            
            ProgressMeter.next!(progress; showvalues = [(:loss, loss)])
            
            if i % trainer.config.checkpoint_freq == 0
                # Save model checkpoint logic
            end
        end
        
        @info "Epoch $epoch average loss: $(total_loss / length(dataset))"
    end
    
    return model
end

function compute_properties_simd(coords::AbstractMatrix{Float32})
    @info "Computing properties with SIMD vectorization"
    n_atoms = size(coords, 1)
    if n_atoms == 0 return Dict("radius_of_gyration" => 0.0f0) end
    
    center_x_sum = 0.0f0
    center_y_sum = 0.0f0
    center_z_sum = 0.0f0
    
    # SIMD version might require careful handling of array bounds and types
    # Sticking to a robust loop for this implementation
    for i in 1:n_atoms
        center_x_sum += coords[i, 1]
        center_y_sum += coords[i, 2]
        center_z_sum += coords[i, 3]
    end
    
    center = SVector{3, Float32}(center_x_sum, center_y_sum, center_z_sum) / n_atoms

    sum_sq_dist = 0.0f0
    for i in 1:n_atoms
        pos = SVector{3, Float32}(coords[i,1], coords[i,2], coords[i,3])
        sum_sq_dist += sum((pos - center) .^ 2)
    end
    
    radius_of_gyration = sqrt(sum_sq_dist / n_atoms)
    
    return Dict("radius_of_gyration" => radius_of_gyration)
end


# predict_secondary_structure with geometric analysis
function predict_secondary_structure(coords::Matrix{Float32})
    @debug "Predicting secondary structure: coords_shape=$(size(coords))"
    n = size(coords,1)
    if n < 3
        return fill("Coil", n)
    end
    secondary = fill("Coil", n)
    for i in 2:n-1
        ca1 = SVector{3, Float32}(coords[i-1,:])
        ca2 = SVector{3, Float32}(coords[i,:])
        ca3 = SVector{3, Float32}(coords[i+1,:])
        vec1 = ca2 - ca1
        vec2 = ca3 - ca2
        angle = acos(clamp(dot(vec1, vec2) / (norm(vec1) * norm(vec2)), -1.0, 1.0))
        if 1.48 < angle < 1.65 # Radians for ~90 degrees
            secondary[i] = "Helix"
        elseif angle > 2.0
            secondary[i] = "Sheet"
        end
    end
    return secondary
end

# compute_solvent_accessibility with surface area calculation
function compute_solvent_accessibility(coords::Matrix{Float32})
    @debug "Computing solvent accessibility: coords_shape=$(size(coords))"
    n = size(coords,1)
    sasa = zeros(Float32, n)
    radius = 1.4f0  # Water molecule radius
    num_samples = 200 # More samples for accuracy

    for i in 1:n
        accessible_points = 0
        current_atom_pos = SVector{3, Float32}(coords[i,:])
        for _ in 1:num_samples
            # Generate random point on a sphere surface
            u, v = rand(Float32), rand(Float32)
            theta = 2 * pi * u
            phi = acos(2 * v - 1)
            offset = SVector{3, Float32}(sin(phi)*cos(theta), sin(phi)*sin(theta), cos(phi))
            
            point = current_atom_pos + radius * offset
            is_occluded = false
            for j in 1:n
                if i != j
                    other_atom_pos = SVector{3, Float32}(coords[j,:])
                    # Using squared distances to avoid sqrt
                    if sum((point - other_atom_pos).^2) < (radius*2)^2
                        is_occluded = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if !is_occluded
                accessible_points += 1
            end
        end
        sasa[i] = (accessible_points / num_samples) * 4 * pi * radius^2
    end
    return sasa
end

function symmetrize(t::AbstractArray{T,3}) where T
    @debug "Symmetrizing tensor: shape=$(size(t))"

function masked_average(t::AbstractArray, mask::AbstractArray, dims; eps=1.0)
    @debug "Masked average: t_shape=$(size(t)), mask_shape=$(size(mask)), dims=$dims"
    num = sum(t .* mask, dims=dims)
    den = sum(mask, dims=dims)
    return num ./ max.(den, eps)
end

function exclusive_cumsum(t::AbstractArray, dim=-1)
    @debug "Exclusive cumulative sum: shape=$(size(t)), dim=$dim"
    if dim == -1
        dim = ndims(t)
    end
    s = size(t)
    cum = cumsum(t, dims=dim)
    shifted = zeros(eltype(t), s...)
    
    # Create indexers for slicing
    colons = [(:) for _ in 1:ndims(t)]
    
    src_indices = copy(colons)
    src_indices[dim] = 1:size(t, dim)-1
    
    dest_indices = copy(colons)
    dest_indices[dim] = 2:size(t, dim)
    
    shifted[dest_indices...] = cum[src_indices...]
    return shifted
end

function pad(t::AbstractArray, pads)
    @debug "Padding tensor: shape=$(size(t)), pads=$pads"
    current_size = size(t)
    new_size = current_size .+ pads
    padded = zeros(eltype(t), new_size...)
    slices = [1:s for s in current_size]
    padded[slices...] = t
    return padded
end

function unpad(t::AbstractArray, pads)
    @debug "Unpadding tensor: shape=$(size(t)), pads=$pads"
    slices = [p+1:size(t,i) for (i, p) in enumerate(pads)]
    return t[slices...]
end

function Attend(; flash=DEFAULT_FLASH_ATTENTION, scale_factor=1.0f0)
    @debug "Initializing Attend: flash=$flash, scale_factor=$scale_factor"
    Attend(flash, scale_factor)
end

function (att::Attend)(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray; mask=nothing, bias=nothing)
    @debug "Attend computation: q_shape=$(size(q)), k_shape=$(size(k)), v_shape=$(size(v))"
    scale = att.scale_factor / sqrt(size(q, ndims(q)))
    
    # Manually implement batch matrix multiplication for more control if needed
    # Here we use einsum for clarity and potential optimization by Einsum.jl
    @einsum scores[b, h, i, j] := q[b, h, i, d] * k[b, h, j, d]
    scores = scores .* scale

    if exists(bias)
        scores = scores .+ bias
    end
    if exists(mask)
        mask_value = max_neg_value(scores)
        scores = scores .+ (1 .- mask) .* mask_value
    end
    attn_weights = softmax(scores, dims=4)
    @einsum result[b, h, i, d] := attn_weights[b, h, i, j] * v[b, h, j, d]
    @info "Attend completed: result_shape=$(size(result))"
    return result
end

    inner_dim = num_heads * dim_head
    q_proj = Flux.Dense(dim, inner_dim, bias=false)
    k_proj = Flux.Dense(dim, inner_dim, bias=false)
    v_proj = Flux.Dense(dim, inner_dim, bias=false)
    out_proj = Flux.Dense(inner_dim, dim)
    Attention(num_heads, dim, dim_head, Attend(flash=flash), q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, out_proj)
end

function (attn::Attention)(x::AbstractArray; mask=nothing, bias=nothing)
    @debug "Attention computation: x_shape=$(size(x))"
    q = attn.q_proj(x)
    k = attn.k_proj(x)
    v = attn.v_proj(x)
    
    q_reshaped = reshape_for_attention(q, attn.num_heads, attn.dim_head)
    k_reshaped = reshape_for_attention(k, attn.num_heads, attn.dim_head)
    v_reshaped = reshape_for_attention(v, attn.num_heads, attn.dim_head)

    # Reshape back
    batch, _, seq, _ = size(out_reshaped)
    out = reshape(permutedims(out_reshaped, (1, 3, 2, 4)), batch, seq, :)
    
    return attn.out_proj(out)
end

    @debug "Initializing RelativePositionEncoding: dim=$dim, max_dist=$max_dist"
    pe = zeros(Float32, 2 * max_dist + 1, dim)
    position = -max_dist:max_dist
    div_term = exp.(collect(0:2:dim-1) .* (-Base.log(10000.0f0) / dim))'
    
    pe[:, 1:2:end] = sin.(position * div_term[:, 1:2:end])
    pe[:, 2:2:end] = cos.(position * div_term[:, 2:2:end])
    
    RelativePositionEncoding(dim, max_dist, pe)

    rel_pos = residue_index .- residue_index'
    rel_pos_clamped = clamp.(rel_pos, -rpe.max_dist, rpe.max_dist)

    return rpe.positional_encoding[indices, :]

function (loss::SmoothLDDTLoss)(pred::AbstractArray, true_val::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing SmoothLDDTLoss: pred_shape=$(size(pred)), true_shape=$(size(true_val))"
    # Assuming pred is logits for bins and true_val is actual distances
    bin_edges = LinRange(loss.min_dist, loss.max_dist, loss.num_bins + 1)
    bin_centers = (bin_edges[1:end-1] .+ bin_edges[2:end]) ./ 2
    
    bin_probs = softmax(pred, dims=3)
    
    # Expand dims for broadcasting
    true_dist_expanded = reshape(true_val, size(true_val)..., 1)
    bin_centers_expanded = reshape(bin_centers, 1, 1, :)
    
    l = sum(abs.(true_dist_expanded .- bin_centers_expanded) .* bin_probs, dims=3)
    return mean(l)
end

function (wra::WeightedRigidAlign)(pred_coords::AbstractArray, true_coords::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing WeightedRigidAlign: pred_shape=$(size(pred_coords)), true_shape=$(size(true_coords))"
    weights_norm = wra.weights ./ (sum(wra.weights) + wra.epsilon)
    pred_center = sum(pred_coords .* weights_norm, dims=1)
    true_center = sum(true_coords .* weights_norm, dims=1)
    pred_shifted = pred_coords .- pred_center
    true_shifted = true_coords .- true_center
    cov = pred_shifted' * diagm(vec(weights_norm)) * true_shifted
    decomp = svd(cov)
    rot = decomp.U * decomp.Vt
    aligned = pred_shifted * rot
    return aligned .+ true_center
end

function (cra::CentreRandomAugmentation)(coords::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Applying random augmentation: coords_shape=$(size(coords))"
    translation = (rand(Float32, 3) .* 2 .* cra.max_translation) .- cra.max_translation
    theta = (rand(Float32) * 2 * cra.max_rotation) - cra.max_rotation
    rot_axis = randn(Float32, 3)
    rot_axis = rot_axis / norm(rot_axis)
    rot_matrix = angle_axis_to_matrix(theta, rot_axis)

    return coords_rotated .+ center .+ translation'
end

function angle_axis_to_matrix(theta::Float32, axis::Vector{Float32})
    @debug "Computing rotation matrix: theta=$theta, axis=$axis"
    c = cos(theta)
    s = sin(theta)
    t = 1 - c
    x, y, z = axis
    return [
        t*x*x+c     t*x*y-z*s   t*x*z+y*s;
        t*x*y+z*s   t*y*y+c     t*y*z-x*s;
        t*x*z-y*s   t*y*z+x*s   t*z*z+c
    ]
end

    out_gated = out .* sigmoid.(tm.out_gate(z))
    return tm.out_proj(out_gated)

struct Trainer
    config::TrainerConfig
    model::Alphafold3
    optimizer::Flux.Optimise.AbstractOptimiser
    loss_fn
end

function Trainer(config::TrainerConfig)
    @debug "Initializing Trainer: learning_rate=$(config.learning_rate), batch_size=$(config.batch_size)"
    model = Alphafold3(config.model_config)
    optimizer = Flux.Adam(config.learning_rate, (0.9, 0.999), config.weight_decay)
    
    loss_fn = (pred, true_data) -> begin
        coords_pred, conf_pred, dist_pred = pred
        coords_true, conf_true, dist_true = true_data
        
        coord_loss = mean((coords_pred .- coords_true) .^ 2)
        # Assuming conf_true and dist_true are binned targets for CE loss
        conf_loss = Flux.logitcrossentropy(conf_pred, conf_true)
        dist_loss = Flux.logitcrossentropy(dist_pred, dist_true)
        
        return coord_loss + conf_loss + dist_loss
    end
    
    Trainer(config, model, optimizer, loss_fn)
end

function train_step!(trainer::Trainer, batch)
    ps = Flux.params(trainer.model)
    loss, grads = Flux.withgradient(ps) do
        # Assuming batch is a tuple of (features, targets)
        features, targets = batch
        predictions = trainer.model(features)
        trainer.loss_fn(predictions, targets)
    end
    Flux.update!(trainer.optimizer, ps, grads)
    return loss
end

function train!(trainer::Trainer, dataset; device_type=DEVICE_TYPE)
    @info "Starting training: device=$device_type, dataset_size=$(length(dataset))"
    model = to_device(trainer.model, device_type)
    
    for epoch in 1:trainer.config.num_epochs
        @info "Epoch $epoch"
        total_loss = 0.0f0
        
        progress = Progress(length(dataset))
        for (i, batch) in enumerate(dataset)
            batch = to_device(batch, device_type)
            loss = train_step!(trainer, batch)
            total_loss += loss
            
            ProgressMeter.next!(progress; showvalues = [(:loss, loss)])
            
            if i % trainer.config.checkpoint_freq == 0
                # Save model checkpoint logic
            end
        end
        
        @info "Epoch $epoch average loss: $(total_loss / length(dataset))"
    end
    
    return model
end

function compute_domains_fast(coords::AbstractMatrix)

    dist_mat = accelerated_distance_matrix(coords)

    graph = Graphs.SimpleGraph(adj_matrix)

function compute_properties_simd(coords::AbstractMatrix{Float32})
    @info "Computing properties with SIMD vectorization"
    n_atoms = size(coords, 1)
    if n_atoms == 0 return Dict("radius_of_gyration" => 0.0f0) end
    
    center_x_sum = 0.0f0
    center_y_sum = 0.0f0
    center_z_sum = 0.0f0
    
    # SIMD version might require careful handling of array bounds and types
    # Sticking to a robust loop for this implementation
    for i in 1:n_atoms
        center_x_sum += coords[i, 1]
        center_y_sum += coords[i, 2]
        center_z_sum += coords[i, 3]
    end
    
    center = SVector{3, Float32}(center_x_sum, center_y_sum, center_z_sum) / n_atoms

    sum_sq_dist = 0.0f0
    for i in 1:n_atoms
        pos = SVector{3, Float32}(coords[i,1], coords[i,2], coords[i,3])
        sum_sq_dist += sum((pos - center) .^ 2)
    end
    
    radius_of_gyration = sqrt(sum_sq_dist / n_atoms)
    
    return Dict("radius_of_gyration" => radius_of_gyration)
end


# predict_secondary_structure with geometric analysis
function predict_secondary_structure(coords::Matrix{Float32})
    @debug "Predicting secondary structure: coords_shape=$(size(coords))"
    n = size(coords,1)
    if n < 3
        return fill("Coil", n)
    end
    secondary = fill("Coil", n)
    for i in 2:n-1
        ca1 = SVector{3, Float32}(coords[i-1,:])
        ca2 = SVector{3, Float32}(coords[i,:])
        ca3 = SVector{3, Float32}(coords[i+1,:])
        vec1 = ca2 - ca1
        vec2 = ca3 - ca2
        angle = acos(clamp(dot(vec1, vec2) / (norm(vec1) * norm(vec2)), -1.0, 1.0))
        if 1.48 < angle < 1.65 # Radians for ~90 degrees
            secondary[i] = "Helix"
        elseif angle > 2.0
            secondary[i] = "Sheet"
        end
    end
    return secondary
end

# compute_solvent_accessibility with surface area calculation
function compute_solvent_accessibility(coords::Matrix{Float32})
    @debug "Computing solvent accessibility: coords_shape=$(size(coords))"
    n = size(coords,1)
    sasa = zeros(Float32, n)
    radius = 1.4f0  # Water molecule radius
    num_samples = 200 # More samples for accuracy

    for i in 1:n
        accessible_points = 0
        current_atom_pos = SVector{3, Float32}(coords[i,:])
        for _ in 1:num_samples
            # Generate random point on a sphere surface
            u, v = rand(Float32), rand(Float32)
            theta = 2 * pi * u
            phi = acos(2 * v - 1)
            offset = SVector{3, Float32}(sin(phi)*cos(theta), sin(phi)*sin(theta), cos(phi))
            
            point = current_atom_pos + radius * offset
            is_occluded = false
            for j in 1:n
                if i != j
                    other_atom_pos = SVector{3, Float32}(coords[j,:])
                    # Using squared distances to avoid sqrt
                    if sum((point - other_atom_pos).^2) < (radius*2)^2
                        is_occluded = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if !is_occluded
                accessible_points += 1
            end
        end
        sasa[i] = (accessible_points / num_samples) * 4 * pi * radius^2
    end
    return sasa
end

A kódrészlet egy Julia/Flux alapú, “AlphaFold 3++ Full Reimplementation in Julia” címkéjű implementáció, amely sok optimalizációs és GPU‑csomagot sorol fel (CUDA/ROCm, AcceleratedKernels, KernelAbstractions, StaticArrays, ThreadsX stb.), és egy “PairformerStack” + fejrészek (distogram, confidence) köré szervezett modellt definiál, számos segédfüggvénnyel (pl. gyors távolságmátrix, domén-keresés, vizualizáció). - AlphaFold 3 a Pairformer modult és egy diffúziós szerkezet‑összeállítót használ, több molekulafajtával (fehérje, DNS/RNS, ligandumok, ionok) és kölcsönhatások közös előrejelzésével; a kódban a diffúziós komponens nincs ténylegesen megvalósítva, a koordinátákat véletlen mátrixként generálja a “structure module” helyén. - Széles Julia-ökoszisztéma integráció: KernelAbstractions/AcceleratedKernels a távolságmátrixhoz, StaticArrays/SIMD a belső számítások gyorsítására, több GPU‑backend (CUDA/ROCm) detektálása, és memóriabarát string/array csomagok.
